About Brand Hut

A rural facility built on purity and people

Brand Hut was established in 2010 in Village Hridaypur, on the outskirts of Baikunthpur, District Kanpur Nagar. The unit was built clean, green and pollution free from the start, and it runs on the daily work of women from the surrounding villages.

Every Master Cook product, from Suji Vermicelli to Suji Macaroni, Pasta and Penne, Frimes and Kachari, is made from wheat flour and suji, packed on site and shipped out to dealers who have worked with the family for years.
